description: Seven launch questions only the app's owner can answer (backups and restore, separate test database, hard spending limits, payment webhook checks, outage alerts, email sender, database plan). Call with no arguments to get the questions and options to ask the user. Call with `answers` ({questionId: optionKey}) to get, for each gap, the fact that makes it matter and a fix prompt. Answers are the owner's word, never graded.
name: greenlit_questions
